Tidemark.

A coastal exploration game about gathering, fishing, cooking, making and repairing an island community’s landmarks.

PrototypeCoastal explorationTouch controlsPlayable
Play on the Tidemark site
THE QUESTION

Can everyday actions connect into a satisfying small adventure?

The approach

Explore Bracken Bay and follow connected projects towards restoring the island beacon. Desktop and touch controls support the same gathering and crafting loop.

Opening the app

The Play button opens Tidemark’s separate existing site. That site has its own access boundary and browser-local saves. Progress does not automatically sync across addresses or devices.
